dimensions.assessment: Affects federal, state, and local government administrators, auditors, and pass-through entities managing federal funds.
dimensions.evidence: Federal funds administered by State and local governments and pass-through entities

dimensions.assessment: Requires an administrative study, report, and vulnerability assessment rather than creating new operational spending programs or mandates.
dimensions.evidence: submit to Congress an assessment of program areas and administrative practices

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific funding allocations or appropriations for conducting the GAO study.
Directs a reporting and auditing requirement for existing state-administered federal grant programs subject to single audit requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Comptroller General of the United States shall submit to Congress an assessment

dimensions.assessment: Requires an initial report not later than 2 years after enactment and periodic updates thereafter.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, and periodically thereafter

missing_information: Cost to the GAO for conducting the assessment
Specific federal programs to be highlighted in the initial report
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Government Accountability Office to submit an assessment and report identifying program areas and administrative practices vulnerable to waste, fraud, and abuse in federally funded, state-administered programs.
